text:
cheng: quick thread — ran paired microbench PCIe vs SXM across two regions (us-west-2 PCIe, us-west-2b SXM racks). Short notes + raw tail numbers.

perf-bot: benchmark job 2115554321 finished: /artifacts/bench-2115554321.tar.gz

sam: can you paste the summary numbers?

cheng: paste:

```
config, seq, GPUs, p50(ms), p95(ms), throughput(tok/s)
PCIe-256, 256, 4, 12.4, 48.7, 3200
SXM-256, 256, 4, 10.8, 36.2, 4100
PCIe-2048, 2048, 4, 140, 420, 420
SXM-2048, 2048, 4, 98, 260, 680
```

maria: wow SXM wins more as seq grows. NVLink helping kv-cache warm hits?

cheng: yes — NVLink lowers cross-GPU KV reads. We measured KV miss->remote fetch latency: PCIe ~1.8ms, SXM ~0.6ms under contention. Also NUMA pinning mattered on PCIe nodes.

sam: what pinning did you try?

cheng: numactl --localalloc + taskset to bind inference threads to the same CPU socket as the GPU PCIe root complex. p95 dropped ~15-25ms on PCIe-2048 runs.

maria: what about kernel variants?

cheng: compared kernels: default (mm-attn), flash_attn2, and fused-cuda. flash_attn2 gave best latency for long seq on SXM. On PCIe, fused-cuda helped when we disabled cross-GPU batching.

sam: quantized runs?

cheng: int8 static quant reduced memory but lowered throughput on PCIe-2048 by ~10% vs fp16; on SXM int8 kept advantage because NVLink reduced spills. Keep an eye on output quality — small hallucination delta on 2048 int8.

maria: action items?

cheng: 1) run numactl pin on PCIe dedicated nodes for next canary (sam). 2) try flash_attn2 + localalloc on PCIe and post numbers (maria). 3) add KV cache warm/miss breakdown to perf dashboard (me).

devops: allocating 2 more PCIe boxes for the canary, ETA 2h.
